evals.prompt: Tengo un libro con 8 hojas adhoc conectadas a FCCS en EPM Cloud (conexión privada 'FCCS_PROD_Consol'). Necesito una macro VBA que cambie el Year y el Period del POV de todas las hojas según lo que ponga en la hoja Control (B1 el año, B2 el periodo), refresque cada hoja y deje en la hoja Control un log de qué hoja falló y por qué. Tiene que poder correr sin que salten MsgBox. Dame el módulo completo y lo que tengo que tener preparado antes.
evals.expected_output: Complete VBA module using HypSetPOV with Dimension#Member items and HypRetrieve, checking every return code, logging HypGetLastError text to Control, no MsgBox, no submit, no passwords; prerequisites: smartview.bas imported and user signed in (cloud: HypConnect not supported).
assertions: Sets the POV with HypSetPOV using 'Dimension#Member' strings (e.g. "Year#" & value)
Checks the return code of HypSetPOV and HypRetrieve for every sheet
Writes the Smart View error text from HypGetLastError (or GetReturnCodeMessage/HypGetErrorInfo) into the Control log
Contains no MsgBox calls in the loop
Does not call HypSubmitData or any submit, calculate or business-rule function
Does not put a password or credentials in the code
States that smartview.bas must be imported as a prerequisite
Warns that on EPM Cloud the macro cannot sign in silently (HypConnect not supported for cloud; the user signs in first or HypUIConnect prompts)
Mentions that if Year/Period sit in grid header rows instead of the POV, HypSetPOV will not change them

evals.prompt: Una controller de un cliente me dice que al abrir Smart View le sale 'Empty response from provider' y justo después 'Invalid MRU item'. Ya ha desinstalado y reinstalado Smart View y sigue igual. Es Planning en EPM Cloud. ¿Qué le digo que haga, paso a paso?
evals.expected_output: Explains both messages are one problem; reinstall does not help because settings live in HKCU registry; steps: browser login test, private connection with URL ending /HyperionPlanning/SmartView, clear recent items, back up and delete registry key, reinstall from instance Downloads; permissions as alternative cause.
assertions: Explains that both messages are the same underlying problem (server returns nothing, recent item marked invalid)
Says the connection URL must end in /HyperionPlanning/SmartView (base instance URL is a typical cause)
Explains reinstalling does not help because settings live in the user registry (HKCU\Software\Hyperion Solutions\HyperionSmartView)
Recommends exporting/backing up the registry key before deleting it
Recommends testing sign-in through the browser with the same user
Recommends clearing the recently used items list
Mentions lost permissions/access as an alternative cause

evals.prompt: Quiero montar una hoja adhoc en Smart View contra el cubo de Planning para cuadrar ventas por entidad y cuenta contra un extracto de SAP. Columnas: los 12 meses de FY26, escenario Actual, versión Final, moneda Local. Filas: entidades E100 a E105 y cuentas 7000 a 7005. Al lado quiero una columna con la diferencia contra SAP. Dame el layout exacto celda a celda para que refresque a la primera.
evals.expected_output: Grid with only members: header rows for Scenario, Version, Currency, Year, Period repeated over data columns; empty top-left corner; entity and account columns; numeric names as text; difference column outside the grid (other sheet or after a blank column); alias table None; each dimension on one axis; save after refresh.
assertions: The grid contains only member names and data cells (no titles or dimension labels inside the grid)
The top-left corner above the row-dimension columns is left empty
Scenario, Version and Currency are placed as column header rows in the grid (not left to the POV)
Each month is a data column with the Year member repeated over every data column
The SAP difference column is outside the grid (separate sheet, or after at least one blank column)
Numeric member names (e.g. 7000 accounts or years) are entered as text / with a leading apostrophe
Advises setting the alias table to None (or using member names consistently)
Every dimension appears on only one axis
